title_en: Ali (peace be upon him) and Fighting over Esoteric Interpretation - Part 37
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari explores Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) and the context of fighting over esoteric interpretation (ta'wil).
